turns.text: Do I require any additional milestone rather than P1-P4 for building PHR application?

must_contain: There is no fifth step: a PHR app is built in four steps, P1, P2, P3 and P4, in that order
One case adds work from the facility side: an app that processes documents the person uploads needs certification as a Health Locker, which requires M2
notes: NHA PHR review, 30 September 2026, case 9: 'Response may not be clear for the user'. Verdict group: language and register. The rejected answer opened with 'You can build a PHR app with P1 to P3' and then listed every P1 route.
